answer.reason: In the EIA Alaska Electricity Profile tables, the IPP & CHP category for Alaska is much smaller than the utility generation category, and the listed value matching IPP & CHP is 670,080 megawatthours, while 6,020,426 megawatthours is consistent with utility net generation.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Alaska Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 6,020,426 megawatthours
B. 670,080 megawatthours

Source citation: Alaska Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/alaska/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: A
